phase.name: Phase F kickoff
phase.goal: Transition from Phase-E readiness artifacts into controlled canary-live execution with auditable promotion approvals and automated rollback governance.

entry_criteria: Phase-E implementation commits are present in pull request #14 with passing targeted validation commands.
Canary readiness criteria config and certification runner produce machine-readable PASS/FAIL artifacts from rollout rehearsal evidence.

priority_work_items.title: Promote canary readiness certification to CI policy gate
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Phase-E canary certification exists, but CI currently gates only on rehearsal outcomes and does not enforce canary-readiness blockers.
scope: Integrate scripts/run_canary_readiness_certification.py into .gitea/workflows/ci.yml after rehearsal report generation.
Fail CI when canary_rollout_certification_report.json overall_status is FAIL.
Persist canary readiness certification report as CI artifact alongside rehearsal evidence.
Expose blocker count and readiness score in CI logs for operator triage.
acceptance_criteria: CI executes canary readiness certification on every relevant pull request.
Merge is blocked when canary certification emits any blockers.
CI output exposes deterministic artifact paths for rehearsal plus certification reports.

priority_work_items.title: Canary stage enablement workflow with audited approval records
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Canary certification captures approval status input, but phase promotion is not yet tied to a persistent approval record and auditable stage-enable workflow.
scope: Define approval record artifact for required approvers (`release_manager`, `runtime_operator_on_call`).
Implement promotion-decision runner that validates certification PASS plus approval record completeness before canary stage enablement.
Write append-only audit evidence for promotion decision and rollback authority assignment.
acceptance_criteria: Promotion decision artifact reports ALLOW/DENY with criterion-level reason codes.
Canary stage enablement is denied when required approvers are missing or certification has blockers.
Approval and promotion actions are persisted as machine-readable audit evidence.

priority_work_items.title: Automated canary rollback enforcement and incident handoff
priority_work_items.problem_statement: Rollback policy is defined for canary operation, but enforcement remains manual and lacks a dedicated incident-handoff artifact.
scope: Implement rollback guard runner that evaluates live-cycle telemetry and canary rollback triggers against configured thresholds.
Emit a rollback incident artifact with trigger evidence, required emergency actions, and responsible authority.
Wire rollback incident artifact into operator runbook documentation and release handoff.
acceptance_criteria: Rollback guard emits PASS/FAIL with reason-coded trigger evidence.
Any triggered rollback condition yields a machine-readable incident artifact and explicit emergency-action list.
Operator documentation includes deterministic rollback handoff sequence and authority mapping.

handoff_notes: Preserve pull-request stream #14 for integrated phase progression visibility.
Use short-lived feature branches under feat/poly-robot-phase-f-* for isolated F-workstreams.
Treat canary readiness blockers and unresolved high-severity rollback triggers as non-negotiable promotion blockers.
